c.title: $3,700 / 2br - 1115ft2 - D272 - Spacious 2 Bedroom + 2 Bathroom Corner Unit in Kitsilano! (Vancouver)
c.description:
Available from October 10, 2026

Welcome to Point Grey Estates in the heart of Kitsilano! This bright and spacious 1,115 sq. ft. corner unit offers 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and a functional layout with excellent separation between the bedrooms and living areas. The home features hardwood flooring, a generous living room with plenty of natural light, a cozy gas fireplace, a separate dining area, and a large kitchen with ample cabinetry, counter space, full-size appliances, and its own window. The spacious primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and private ensuite. Enjoy a large south-facing balcony surrounded by greenery, perfect for relaxing outdoors. The unit also includes 2 parking stalls and 1 storage locker. Ideally located on West 4th Avenue in Kitsilano, between Kits Beach and Jericho Beach, with convenient access to beaches, parks, restaurants, shopping, transit, and everyday amenities.

To arrange a showing please provide us with the following information:

1) Full name.
2) Phone number and email address.
3) Desired move in date.
4) What is the number of occupants.
5) What is your current employment status, occupation, and household annual income.

Please note:
* Minimum one year lease
* Unit is unfurnished
* Security deposit required
* No smoking (includes e-cigarettes, marijuana etc)
* Two parking space included.
* References and credit check required
* Tenant Insurance is required
* One storage locker.

The property address is - 3220 W 4TH AVE, VANCOUVER BC V6K 1R9

Listed by - My Dream Realty
